X) Parasites evolve more slowly than hosts, leading to eventual host resistance. Y) Both hosts and parasites continuously evolve in response to each other Z) Hosts evolve to eliminate parasites completely

choices.X: Parasites evolve more slowly than hosts, leading to eventual host resistance.
choices.Y: Both hosts and parasites continuously evolve in response to each other
